test.title: Planting a hedge instead of a fence

paragraphs.text: A hedge costs more to plant than a wooden fence but lasts far longer. A well-cut hedge of hawthorn may stand for a century, while a fence is usually replaced after fifteen years.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Hedges also shelter birds, and a thick hedge slows the wind across a field better than a solid barrier, which creates gusts on the far side. They must be cut every year or two, usually in late winter.
paragraphs.label: B

document.title: Planting a hedge instead of a fence

items.quote: A hedge costs more to plant than a wooden fence
items.prompt: A hedge is cheaper to plant than a fence.

explanation.en: A hedge costs more to plant → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Живая изгородь дороже в посадке → FALSE.

items.quote: a fence is usually replaced after fifteen years
items.prompt: A fence normally lasts longer than fifteen years.

explanation.en: A fence is usually replaced after fifteen years → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Қоршау әдетте он бес жылдан кейін ауыстырылады → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Забор обычно меняют через пятнадцать лет → FALSE.

items.quote: a solid barrier, which creates gusts on the far side
items.prompt: A solid barrier causes gusts behind it.

explanation.en: “creates gusts on the far side” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «creates gusts on the far side» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.
explanation.ru: «creates gusts on the far side» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.

items.quote: A well-cut hedge of hawthorn may stand for a century
items.prompt: Hawthorn is the best plant for a hedge.

explanation.en: Hawthorn is given as an example, not called the best → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Долана мысал ретінде аталған, бірақ ең жақсы деп айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Боярышник упомянут как пример, но лучшим его не называют → NOT GIVEN.
